community_list_entries.name: APM-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-session Persistent Memory for Egocentric Streaming Video Assistants

phase1_classification.kind_reason: A benchmark of 549 video sessions in 104 multi-session egocentric trajectories, with 2,719 candidates. It tests cross-session persistent memory: episodic recall, entity state tracking, temporal reasoning, proactive response and recognizing missing evidence.
